decision.title: Substrate review at the Phase 1 gate (packet )

body.p: by the Phase 1 review agent (). Before the freeze () every record that touched the substrate headers (-, , , , , ) was checked against the Phase 2-4 task files; "Proposed" was empty. All earlier records stand. Found and changed:

item.p: Base URI of a parentless root (tree.h): the arena tree had no way to give a constructed element, attribute, text, comment or PI a base URI; only start_document carried one, but XQuery 4.0 constructors (packet ) need the static base URI and XSLT 4.0 the instruction's (section 11.1: it matters only for a parentless node, a child takes its parent's; XQuery copies behave the same, QT4 cbcl-base-uri-001 to -004). New field sxml_arena_tree_configuration.base_uri, copied by finish, reported as sxml_tree_description.base_uri; zero keeps the old behaviour.

Parentless namespace nodes (tree.h, contract only): computed namespace constructors and xsl:namespace make namespace nodes without an element, which 's (element, namespace number) cannot name. A tree may now hold one stored namespace node, its root (index 0, namespace number 0), built by an add_namespace_binding sent first; its name is the prefix, its content the URI (empty URI: XQDY0101). The arena tree and sxml_tree_builder_copy_node implement it (src/arena_tree.c, src/tree.c, test parentless_namespace_nodes_are_stored); the adaptive serializer and the evaluator's namespace paths still assume an element and are packets and 's.
Named item types (types.h, comment): find_type no longer claims to find them; XQuery declare type and xsl:item-type are aliases in a module's static context, never registered by name.
Host re-entry (xdm.h, comment): a host function body, generator, resolver or builder that starts an evaluation nests it on the C stack; bounding that is the host's ( holds for sxml's own code).

status.h, string.h: "" is Unicode's definition , not this file's. Deferred, each needing its own record when it comes: adopting heap buffers for strings (Phase 0 question 7, only if Phase 2 profiling asks), registering schema-derived atomic types (Phase 5), a frozen shareable tree (), a per-element base URI for XSLT literal result elements that come from different stylesheet modules and are copied as parentless nodes with relative xml:base (no QT4 or XSLT test seen needs it).
